It defines the scope of practice for VPAs, allows them to engage in veterinary medicine under specified conditions, and restricts certain activities they cannot perform.

bills.title: Practice of Veterinary Medicine
bills.last_action: Died in Industries & Professional Activities Subcommittee
bills.summary_ai: This bill establishes licensing requirements and scope of practice for veterinary technicians, including continuing education standards and disciplinary procedures. It defines what tasks supervising veterinarians can delegate to licensed veterinary technicians and prohibits unlicensed individuals from using protected titles or performing restricted duties.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)
bills.regulatory_type: licensure, scope of practice, title protection, delegation, continuing education

bills.title: An Act Concerning Service Animals In Insurance Underwriting, The Appointment Of An Advocate In Proceedings Concerning The Welfare Or Custody Of Companion Animals, Assault Of A Domestic Animal And Establishing An Animal Abuse Task Force.
bills.last_action: Favorable Change of Reference, Senate to Committee on Judiciary
bills.summary_ai: This bill establishes an animal abuse task force and expands legal protections for animals, which creates demand for veterinary professionals to document injuries, provide expert testimony, and participate in abuse investigations. Veterinary technicians and assistants may be called upon to support veterinarians in examining abused animals and contributing to legal proceedings regarding animal welfare.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: An Act Concerning Credit Cards And Health And Veterinary Care Services.
bills.summary_ai: This bill restricts veterinary care providers from advertising, promoting, or assisting consumers with medical credit cards, and prohibits charging for services before they are provided or for ancillary products without separate consent. It establishes disclosure requirements and refund obligations regarding medical credit cards and ancillary products.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Sunset Pet Animal Care & Facilities Act
bills.summary_ai: This bill concerns the continuation and licensing of pet animal care facilities under the Pet Animal Care and Facilities Act, which directly impacts where veterinary paraprofessionals work and the regulatory standards they must follow. The sunset review may affect facility requirements, standards of care, and working conditions for technicians and assistants employed in these settings.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Access to Veterinary Care
bills.summary_ai: This bill aims to increase access to veterinary care through expedited licensing by endorsement for veterinarians and clarification of prescription and compounded drug use. While primarily focused on veterinarian licensure and drug protocols, it impacts the paraprofessional workforce by potentially expanding delegation opportunities and clarifying the regulatory environment in which veterinary technicians and other paraprofessionals operate.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary medicine.
bills.last_action: Read second time. Ordered to third reading.
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends California's veterinary medicine statutes by modifying multiple sections governing veterinary practice and adding new regulatory sections. categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Criminal history information: background checks.
bills.last_action: In Senate. Read first time. To Com. on RLS. for assignment.
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends California law regarding criminal history background checks across multiple professions and industries. It may affect veterinary paraprofessionals if background check requirements are modified for positions working with animals or in veterinary facilities.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Antimicrobial resistance.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Res. Chapter 103, Statutes of 2026.
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses antimicrobial resistance, which is directly relevant to veterinary paraprofessionals who administer medications, assist in surgical procedures, and play a key role in implementing proper antimicrobial stewardship protocols in veterinary practices. Paraprofessionals must understand appropriate antimicrobial use to prevent resistance and support evidence-based prescribing practices under veterinarian supervision.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary medicine: cat declawing.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Chapter 479, Statutes of 2025.
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends veterinary practice law to restrict or regulate cat declawing procedures, which directly impacts the clinical procedures that veterinary paraprofessionals may be authorized to perform or assist with under veterinary supervision. The changes to Sections 4826, 4827, and 4883 likely define what surgical procedures fall within permissible veterinary practice.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Registered veterinary technicians and veterinary assistants: scope of practice.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Chapter 371, Statutes of 2025.
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends California Business and Professions Code Section 4840 to modify the scope of practice for registered veterinary technicians and veterinary assistants. The legislation directly addresses what tasks and procedures these paraprofessionals are authorized to perform under veterinary supervision.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinarians: veterinarian-client-patient relationship.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State. Chapter 589, Statutes of 2025.
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends regulations regarding the veterinarian-client-patient relationship (VCPR), which is a foundational legal requirement that establishes when and how veterinarians can delegate tasks to paraprofessionals. Changes to VCPR requirements directly impact what duties veterinary paraprofessionals can perform and under what supervision conditions.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary medicine: California Veterinary Medical Board.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Chapter 195, Statutes of 2025.
bills.summary_ai: This California bill comprehensively amends the Veterinary Medical Board's regulatory framework by modifying multiple sections of the Business and Professions Code governing veterinary practice. The amendments likely address scope of practice, licensure, supervision, and discipline for veterinary professionals including paraprofessionals.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

Adequate funding for higher education institutions is essential for maintaining and expanding veterinary technician and related paraprofessional training programs.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary practices; ownership; oversight
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses ownership and oversight of veterinary practices, which directly impacts the working conditions, authority structures, and professional relationships of veterinary paraprofessionals. Ownership rules and oversight mechanisms determine who can manage practices where paraprofessionals are employed and how they are supervised.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Animal abuse; animal neglect; classification
bills.summary_ai: This bill establishes legal classifications and definitions for animal abuse and neglect, which directly impacts the professional responsibilities of veterinary paraprofessionals who must recognize, document, and report suspected animal cruelty in clinical and field settings. Veterinary technicians and assistants are often frontline workers in identifying abuse cases and may be required to fulfill mandatory reporting obligations under such legislation.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary technicians; education alternative; certifications
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses veterinary technician workforce development by creating alternative educational pathways and establishing certification standards for veterinary technicians. It directly impacts how veterinary paraprofessionals can qualify for practice through varied education and credentialing mechanisms.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary technicians; certification; education alternative
bills.last_action: House LARA Committee action: Held, voting: (0-0-0-0-0-0)

bills.title: Statewide Spay & Neuter Program
bills.summary_ai: This bill establishes a statewide spay and neuter assistance program and fund, which directly impacts veterinary services and the procedures performed by veterinary paraprofessionals. The program increases demand for spay and neuter surgeries, a core procedure performed by veterinary technicians and technologists under veterinarian supervision.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Professional Licensing; Temp Permits
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses temporary professional licenses for certain professions, which could enable veterinary paraprofessionals to work under temporary permits while completing licensure requirements or during workforce shortages. The legislation may facilitate faster entry into the veterinary workforce for technicians, technologists, nurses, and other paraprofessional categories.

bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses temporary professional licenses for certain professions, which could enable veterinary paraprofessionals to practice under temporary permits while completing licensure requirements or during workforce shortages. The provision of temporary licensing pathways is directly applicable to veterinary technicians, technologists, nurses, and other paraprofessional categories.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Disaster Emergency Plan For Pets
bills.summary_ai: This bill establishes a disaster emergency plan for pets and service animals in Alaska, specifically involving veterinarians and veterinarian technicians in emergency response procedures. The legislation addresses how veterinary paraprofessionals participate in state and local emergency planning coordination during disasters.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Emergency Med Svcs; Operational Canines
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses emergency medical services for operational canines and modifies veterinary practice law, including the powers and duties of veterinarians and their liability. It directly impacts veterinary professionals' scope of practice and responsibilities in providing emergency medical care to working dogs.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Health care; allied health professionals, training; tuition grants and loan forgiveness; Rural Allied Health Professional Workforce Expansion Act and Rural Clinical Training Partnership Fund created
bills.last_action: Pending House Ways and Means General Fund

The legislation aims to increase workforce capacity and accessibility of veterinary services in underserved rural communities through financial incentives for training and education.

bills.summary_ai: This bill defines and clarifies the scope of practice for veterinarians both within and outside the veterinarian-client-patient relationship (VCPR), which directly impacts what tasks and responsibilities can be delegated to veterinary paraprofessionals. By specifying veterinarian scope of practice boundaries, it establishes the framework within which all veterinary paraprofessional categories operate.
